Setting the Cyber & Zero-Trust scene in Warehousing & Fulfillment: Fulfillment is throughput economics: pick rates, dock scheduling, labor allocation and inventory truth. Orchestrated robots, vision-verified quality and agentic labor planning compound into cost-per-order leadership.

Inventory truth drifting is the concrete face of a general problem: the work is shaped for a world of manual checks and batch updates, while volume and scrutiny both grew. We start with the queue, the wait and the number they produce, not with a platform license.

Inside Warehousing & Fulfillment, Achala runs Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust under the same delivery standard as every engagement: Achala builds routing, telematics and warehouse decision systems with measured utilization gains — up to 40% workforce efficiency in published fleet deployments. The baseline is signed before delivery starts.

The build treats those duties as design inputs, which is why evidence exists by the time anyone asks for it.
